newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Jan-May retail/trade vol. drops 6.3pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Jan-May retail/trade vol. drops 6.3pct y/y.

text.p: The volume of Hungary's retail and catering sales dropped 6.3 percent in the first five months of the year from the same period of 1996, the Central Statistical Office (KSH) said on Tuesday.
HUNGARY RETAIL TRADE AND CATERING VOLUME (Yr/yr pct change)
HUNGARY RETAIL TRADE AND CATERING TURNOVER (Forint blns)
NOTE - The total volume of retail trade and catering rose three percent in May from April according to seasonally adjusted figures, continuing this year's rising trend, the KSH said.
However, in year-on-year terms, the volume dropped almost two percent in May, but the pace of fall has been slowing since January, the KSH said.

The country's retail and catering turnover totalled 260 billion forints in May, up 13.5 percent year-on-year at nominal value but down two percent according to seasonally adjusted figures, the KSH said.
Hungary's inflation ran at 17.7 percent in May.
